name: GHS
recent: GHS 近期宣布以 RM4,000,000 现金收购位于 Melaka Krubong 的一处工业物业，并已签署有条件买卖协议。同期，公司执行董事 Yeo Tian Seng 多次在公开市场增持股份。公司也完成了 2026 财年第二次中期股息的派发。
notable: 全资子公司 GHS Food Industries 与 Angel Court (M) 签署有条件买卖协议，以 RM4,000,000 现金收购 Melaka 一处带仓库和办公楼的工业物业。
执行董事 Yeo Tian Seng 于 2026 年 9 月至 11 月期间多次在公开市场增持公司股份。
公司派发 2026 财年第二次中期单层股息每股 0.25 仙。

recent_en: GHS recently announced the proposed acquisition of an industrial property in Krubong, Melaka for RM4,000,000 cash via a conditional sale and purchase agreement. Meanwhile, Executive Director Yeo Tian Seng has been acquiring shares in the open market on multiple occasions. The company also completed the payment of its second interim dividend for FY2026.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary GHS Food Industries signed a conditional SPA with Angel Court (M) to acquire an industrial property with a warehouse and office building in Melaka for RM4,000,000 cash.
Executive Director Yeo Tian Seng acquired shares in the open market on multiple occasions between September and November 2026.
The company paid a second interim single-tier dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026.
